brief:
Turkey's presidency responded Saturday to statements from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government targeting Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, characterizing the remarks as a reflection of Israeli government dysfunction, Shehab Wire reported. The Turkish response framed Netanyahu's comments as evidence of Israel's inability to address international justice proceedings.

The exchange marked an escalation in rhetoric between Ankara and Jerusalem. Turkish officials used the occasion to suggest that Israel's criticism of Erdoğan stemmed not from substantive policy disagreements but from the Netanyahu administration's weakness on the global stage. The statement implied that Israeli leaders resort to personal attacks when facing pressure over their legal exposure in international courts.

title: Turkey accuses Netanyahu government of political crisis and legal weakness
